      • findSourceTDE

        private static TDE findSourceTDE(TDEVar data)
        Search backwards from a TDEVar to find a source that is a TDE of type ELEMENT. If a constant TDEVar is found or a TDE that is not type ELEMENT then null is returned. The search will pass back through CONNECT TDEs.
        Parameters:
        data - is the starting TDEVar
        Returns:
        the ELEMENT TDE or else null

      • singleDest

        private static boolean singleDest(TDEVar d,
                                  TDE tde)
        Follow all signal paths forward from 'd' through any CONNECT TDEs until a CONNECT with no output signal is encountered or TDE 'tde' is encountered. If any other TDE is encountered return false.
        Parameters:
        d - is the starting signal
        tde - is a terminating TDE
        Returns:
        true if single destination is found

      • optimise_dsp48_alu

        private static void optimise_dsp48_alu(TDE tde,
                                       java.util.ArrayList<TDE> new_tdes)
        If possible substitute a DSP48 ALU for a selector with inputs which are arithmetic or logical operations. THIS IS FOR A DSP48E and DSP48E1 - NEED CHANGES FOR DSP48, DSP48A1
        Parameters:
        tde - is a selector TDE with an ALU or DSP flag
        new_tdes - is a list of newly created TDEs to be added later to the TDE list
